title: LossChart.makePath emits 'NaN' path coordinates for non-finite loss points
description: makePath filters points with `e[key] != null` (line 42), so a NaN/Infinity value produces a path segment like `L12.3,NaN`. Even setting aside the y-range poisoning above, an individual non-finite point yields an invalid SVG path `d` string. The sibling LossTab.makePath guards with `isFiniteNumber(e[key])` and skips such points entirely (LossTab.tsx:83), producing a clean broken-line path. LossChart should do the same.
evidence: LossChart.tsx:42 `e[key] != null ? \`L${xScale(i)},${yScale(e[key])}\` : null` with yScale(NaN)=NaN -> 'L..,NaN'. LossTab.tsx:83 `if (!isFiniteNumber(e[key])) return null`.
